title.en: IELTS Writing: Change, comparison and the overview sentence
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Oʻzgarish, solishtirish va umumiy koʻrinish gapi
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Изменение, сравнение и предложение-обзор

body.en:
Lesson 1 showed you the overview. Now make every overview sentence do one of two jobs.
1. Describe a change: a verb and how fast or how much. rose sharply, increased slightly, fell gradually, dropped, remained stable, doubled, overtook.
2. Compare: higher than, twice as many as, the most, the least, while, whereas.
The strongest overview sentence often does both: "Sales of cold drinks doubled, while hot drinks fell gradually."
For past years, the verbs are in the past: rose, fell, remained.
body.uz:
1-darsda umumiy koʻrinish (overview) bilan tanishdingiz. Endi umumiy koʻrinishdagi har bir gap ikki vazifadan birini bajarsin.
1. Oʻzgarishni tasvirlash: feʼl va oʻzgarish qanchalik tez yoki qancha boʻlgani. rose sharply, increased slightly, fell gradually, dropped, remained stable, doubled, overtook.
2. Solishtirish: higher than, twice as many as, the most, the least, while, whereas.
Eng kuchli umumiy koʻrinish gapi koʻpincha ikkalasini ham qiladi: «Sales of cold drinks doubled, while hot drinks fell gradually.»
Oʻtgan yillar haqida feʼllar oʻtgan zamonda boʻladi: rose, fell, remained.
body.ru:
В уроке 1 вы познакомились с обзором (overview). Теперь пусть каждое предложение обзора выполняет одну из двух задач.
1. Описать изменение: глагол и то, насколько быстро или сильно что-то изменилось. rose sharply, increased slightly, fell gradually, dropped, remained stable, doubled, overtook.
2. Сравнить: higher than, twice as many as, the most, the least, while, whereas.
Самое сильное предложение обзора часто делает и то и другое: «Sales of cold drinks doubled, while hot drinks fell gradually.»
Если речь о прошлых годах, глаголы ставятся в прошедшем времени: rose, fell, remained.

body.en:
A model on another chart (our own example). Visits to three activities at a sports centre, in thousands:
2016: swimming 50, gym 30, tennis 20
2020: swimming 45, gym 50, tennis 15
2024: swimming 40, gym 60, tennis 15

The chart compares the number of visits to three activities at a sports centre in 2016, 2020 and 2024. Overall, the gym became far more popular and overtook swimming, while both swimming and tennis lost visitors. Gym visits rose throughout the period and doubled in total, whereas swimming fell gradually. By 2024, the gym attracted one and a half times as many visits as swimming. Tennis was the least popular activity in every year shown, and after a small fall it remained stable.
body.uz:
Boshqa grafik boʻyicha namuna (oʻzimizning misol). Sport markazidagi uchta mashgʻulotga tashriflar soni, ming hisobida:
2016: suzish 50, sport zali 30, tennis 20
2020: suzish 45, sport zali 50, tennis 15
2024: suzish 40, sport zali 60, tennis 15

The chart compares the number of visits to three activities at a sports centre in 2016, 2020 and 2024. Overall, the gym became far more popular and overtook swimming, while both swimming and tennis lost visitors. Gym visits rose throughout the period and doubled in total, whereas swimming fell gradually. By 2024, the gym attracted one and a half times as many visits as swimming. Tennis was the least popular activity in every year shown, and after a small fall it remained stable.

Eʼtibor bering: umumiy koʻrinishdagi har bir gap yo oʻzgarishni (rose throughout, fell gradually), yo solishtirishni (while, whereas, one and a half times as many) aytadi. Mayda raqamlar yoʻq.
body.ru:
Образец по другому графику (наш собственный пример). Число посещений трёх видов занятий в спортивном центре, тыс.:
2016: плавание 50, тренажёрный зал 30, теннис 20
2020: плавание 45, тренажёрный зал 50, теннис 15
2024: плавание 40, тренажёрный зал 60, теннис 15

The chart compares the number of visits to three activities at a sports centre in 2016, 2020 and 2024. Overall, the gym became far more popular and overtook swimming, while both swimming and tennis lost visitors. Gym visits rose throughout the period and doubled in total, whereas swimming fell gradually. By 2024, the gym attracted one and a half times as many visits as swimming. Tennis was the least popular activity in every year shown, and after a small fall it remained stable.

Обратите внимание: каждое предложение обзора либо описывает изменение (rose throughout, fell gradually), либо сравнивает (while, whereas, one and a half times as many). Мелких цифр нет.

body.en: Two traps. First: the wrong tense. For past years write "rose" and "fell", not "rises" or "is falling". Second: a comparison with only one side. "The gym was more popular." More popular than what? Name both sides: "more popular than swimming". And check the numbers before you write "doubled" or "tripled": 30 to 60 is double, 30 to 70 is not.
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: notoʻgʻri zamon. Oʻtgan yillar haqida «rises» yoki «is falling» emas, «rose» va «fell» deb yozing. Ikkinchisi: faqat bir tomoni bor solishtirish. «The gym was more popular.» Nimadan koʻra mashhurroq? Ikkala tomonni ham ayting: «more popular than swimming». «doubled» yoki «tripled» deb yozishdan oldin raqamlarni tekshiring: 30 dan 60 ga oʻsish ikki baravar, 30 dan 70 ga esa yoʻq.
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: не то время. О прошлых годах пишите «rose» и «fell», а не «rises» или «is falling». Вторая: сравнение без второй стороны. «The gym was more popular.» Популярнее, чем что? Назовите обе стороны: «more popular than swimming». И проверьте цифры, прежде чем писать «doubled» или «tripled»: с 30 до 60 — это рост вдвое, с 30 до 70 — нет.

prompt.en: The chart below shows how many people visited three places in one town (a museum, a zoo and a water park) in 2012, 2017 and 2022. Write one sentence that says what the chart shows, then an overview of the main changes and comparisons. (The town and all figures are invented for practice.)

data.en:
Visitors to each place (thousands):
2012: museum 60, zoo 90, water park 30
2017: museum 55, zoo 80, water park 70
2022: museum 58, zoo 70, water park 110

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: one sentence on what the chart shows (in your own words), then 2 or 3 overview sentences. Each overview sentence describes a change (rose sharply, fell steadily) or compares (while, whereas, the most). No small numbers.
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: grafik nimani koʻrsatishi haqida bitta gap (oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan), keyin 2-3 gaplik umumiy koʻrinish. Undagi har bir gap oʻzgarishni tasvirlasin (rose sharply, fell steadily) yoki solishtirsin (while, whereas, the most). Mayda raqamlar boʻlmasin.
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60–150 слов: одно предложение о том, что показывает график (своими словами), затем 2–3 предложения обзора. Каждое из них описывает изменение (rose sharply, fell steadily) или сравнивает (while, whereas, the most). Без мелких цифр.

rubric.en: Task: one sentence says what the chart shows; the overview names the main changes (the water park rose sharply and became the most visited place, the zoo fell steadily, the museum stayed about the same) and does not list every number.

ask.en: Did you say what the chart shows, and name the main changes (the water park up and first by 2022, the zoo down, the museum about the same)?
ask.uz: Grafik nimani koʻrsatishini aytdingizmi va asosiy oʻzgarishlarni (akvaparkka tashriflar keskin oshdi va 2022-yilga kelib u birinchi oʻringa chiqdi, hayvonot bogʻiga tashriflar kamaydi, muzeyniki deyarli oʻzgarmadi) nomladingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы сказали, что показывает график, и назвали главные изменения (посещаемость аквапарка резко выросла, и к 2022 году он стал первым, у зоопарка она упала, у музея почти не изменилась)?

rubric.en: Organisation: the introduction sentence first, then the overview starting with "Overall"; each overview sentence describes a change or makes a comparison, and the biggest change comes first.

ask.en: Is the introduction sentence first? Does each overview sentence describe a change or compare, with the biggest change first?
ask.uz: Kirish gapi birinchi turibdimi? Umumiy koʻrinishdagi har bir gap oʻzgarishni tasvirlaydimi yoki solishtiradimi, eng katta oʻzgarish birinchi keladimi?
ask.ru: Вступительное предложение стоит первым? Каждое предложение обзора описывает изменение или сравнивает, и самое большое изменение идёт первым?

rubric.en: Words: verbs and adverbs of change (rose sharply, fell steadily, remained stable, overtook) and words that compare (while, whereas, the most visited, more than three times as many).

ask.en: Did you use a change verb with an adverb (rose sharply, fell steadily) and one comparing word (while, whereas)?
ask.uz: Oʻzgarish feʼlini ravish bilan (rose sharply, fell steadily) va bitta solishtiruvchi soʻzni (while, whereas) ishlatdingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы использовали глагол изменения с наречием (rose sharply, fell steadily) и одно слово сравнения (while, whereas)?

rubric.en: Grammar: past tenses for past years, comparatives and superlatives formed correctly (more popular than, the most visited), and while or whereas joining two full clauses.

ask.en: Are the verbs in the past for past years? Check one comparison (more … than, the most …) and one sentence with while or whereas: is there a full clause on each side?
ask.uz: Oʻtgan yillar haqidagi feʼllar oʻtgan zamondami? Bitta solishtirishni (more … than, the most …) va while yoki whereas bilan bitta gapni tekshiring: ikki tomonida ham toʻliq gap bormi?
ask.ru: Глаголы о прошлых годах стоят в прошедшем времени? Проверьте одно сравнение (more … than, the most …) и одно предложение с while или whereas: с обеих сторон полное предложение?

body.en:
Some Task 1 questions have no numbers: a process (how something is made or how it works) or two maps of one place at two times.
A process:
1. Count the stages and name the first and the last.
2. Say whether it is a line (it ends somewhere new) or a cycle (it comes back to the start).
3. Use the passive, because the action matters, not who does it: "The dough is mixed."
4. Use sequence words: first, next, after that, once this is done, finally.
Two maps:
1. The overview names the biggest changes and what stayed the same.
2. Use "was replaced by", "was turned into", "has been built".
3. Say where: in the north, next to, opposite.
body.uz:
Baʼzi Task 1 savollarida raqam boʻlmaydi: jarayon (biror narsa qanday tayyorlanadi yoki qanday ishlaydi) yoki bitta joyning ikki xil vaqtdagi ikkita xaritasi.
Jarayon:
1. Bosqichlarni sanang, birinchisi va oxirgisini ayting.
2. Jarayon chiziqli (yangi joyda tugaydi) yoki aylanma (boshiga qaytadi) ekanini ayting.
3. Majhul nisbatdan foydalaning, chunki kim qilgani emas, harakatning oʻzi muhim: «The dough is mixed.»
4. Ketma-ketlik soʻzlarini ishlating: first, next, after that, once this is done, finally.
Ikki xarita:
1. Umumiy koʻrinish eng katta oʻzgarishlarni va nima oʻzgarmay qolganini aytadi.
2. «was replaced by», «was turned into», «has been built» shakllarini ishlating.
3. Qayerdaligini ayting: in the north, next to, opposite.
body.ru:
В некоторых заданиях Task 1 нет цифр: процесс (как что-то делают или как это работает) или две карты одного места в разное время.
Процесс:
1. Посчитайте этапы и назовите первый и последний.
2. Скажите, линейный это процесс (заканчивается в новом месте) или цикл (возвращается к началу).
3. Используйте пассив, потому что важно действие, а не тот, кто его выполняет: «The dough is mixed.»
4. Используйте слова последовательности: first, next, after that, once this is done, finally.
Две карты:
1. Обзор называет самые большие изменения и то, что осталось прежним.
2. Используйте «was replaced by», «was turned into», «has been built».
3. Говорите, где: in the north, next to, opposite.

body.en:
A model on another diagram (our own example). How a small bakery makes bread each morning:
1. Flour, water, salt and yeast are mixed into dough.
2. The dough is left for two hours to rise.
3. It is cut and shaped into loaves.
4. The loaves are baked for 40 minutes.
5. They are cooled on racks.
6. The bread is packed and delivered to shops.

The diagram illustrates the six stages that a small bakery follows to produce its bread each morning. Overall, the process is a simple line: it begins with four basic ingredients being mixed and ends with the finished loaves being delivered to shops. Only two stages are given a time, and the longer of these is the two hours in which the dough is left to rise. Once it has risen, the dough is shaped into loaves, which are then baked for 40 minutes and cooled before they are packed.
body.uz:
Boshqa diagramma boʻyicha namuna (oʻzimizning misol). Kichik novvoyxona har kuni ertalab nonni qanday tayyorlaydi:
1. Un, suv, tuz va xamirturush aralashtirilib, xamir qilinadi.
2. Xamir oshishi uchun ikki soatga qoldiriladi.
3. U boʻlinib, non shakliga keltiriladi.
4. Nonlar 40 daqiqa pishiriladi.
5. Ular tokchalarda sovitiladi.
6. Non qadoqlanib, doʻkonlarga yetkaziladi.

The diagram illustrates the six stages that a small bakery follows to produce its bread each morning. Overall, the process is a simple line: it begins with four basic ingredients being mixed and ends with the finished loaves being delivered to shops. Only two stages are given a time, and the longer of these is the two hours in which the dough is left to rise. Once it has risen, the dough is shaped into loaves, which are then baked for 40 minutes and cooled before they are packed.

Eʼtibor bering: umumiy koʻrinish bosqichlar sonini, boshlanishi va oxirini aytadi; bosqichlar majhul nisbatda (is left, are baked) va ketma-ketlik soʻzlari bilan (once, then) yozilgan.
body.ru:
Образец по другой схеме (наш собственный пример). Как небольшая пекарня каждое утро печёт хлеб:
1. Муку, воду, соль и дрожжи смешивают в тесто.
2. Тесто оставляют на два часа подниматься.
3. Его делят и формуют буханки.
4. Буханки выпекают 40 минут.
5. Их остужают на решётках.
6. Хлеб упаковывают и развозят по магазинам.

The diagram illustrates the six stages that a small bakery follows to produce its bread each morning. Overall, the process is a simple line: it begins with four basic ingredients being mixed and ends with the finished loaves being delivered to shops. Only two stages are given a time, and the longer of these is the two hours in which the dough is left to rise. Once it has risen, the dough is shaped into loaves, which are then baked for 40 minutes and cooled before they are packed.

Обратите внимание: обзор называет число этапов, начало и конец; этапы описаны в пассиве (is left, are baked) и со словами последовательности (once, then).

body.en: Two traps. First: copying the stages word for word. Change the form where you can: "Flour, water, salt and yeast are mixed" can become "the ingredients are combined". Second, on maps: the present tense for the old map. The old map is the past ("There was a car park"); for the change, use the past or the present perfect ("A playground has been built").
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: bosqichlarni soʻzma-soʻz koʻchirish. Imkon boricha shaklini oʻzgartiring: «Flour, water, salt and yeast are mixed» oʻrniga «the ingredients are combined» deyish mumkin. Ikkinchisi, xaritalarda: eski xarita haqida hozirgi zamon. Eski xarita oʻtgan zamonda tasvirlanadi («There was a car park»); oʻzgarish uchun oʻtgan zamon yoki present perfect ishlating («A playground has been built»).
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: переписывать этапы слово в слово. Где можно, меняйте форму: «Flour, water, salt and yeast are mixed» можно заменить на «the ingredients are combined». Вторая, на картах: настоящее время для старой карты. Старая карта — это прошлое («There was a car park»); для изменения используйте прошедшее время или present perfect («A playground has been built»).

prompt.en: The diagram below shows how one school turns food waste into compost for its garden. Write one sentence that says what the diagram shows, then an overview of the process. (The school and its process are invented for practice.)

data.en:
Stages shown in the diagram:
1. Fruit and vegetable waste is collected from the school canteen.
2. The waste is cut into small pieces.
3. It is mixed with dry leaves in a large wooden box.
4. The mixture is turned once a week for eight weeks.
5. The finished compost is sieved.
6. It is spread on the school garden, where vegetables are grown.
7. The vegetables are picked and cooked in the canteen.

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: one sentence on what the diagram shows (in your own words), then an overview: how many stages, where the process begins and ends, and whether it is a line or a cycle. Use the passive (is collected, are picked).
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: diagramma nimani koʻrsatishi haqida bitta gap (oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan), keyin umumiy koʻrinish: nechta bosqich, jarayon qayerda boshlanib, qayerda tugaydi, u chiziqli jarayonmi yoki aylanma jarayonmi. Majhul nisbatdan foydalaning (is collected, are picked).
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60–150 слов: одно предложение о том, что показывает схема (своими словами), затем обзор: сколько этапов, где процесс начинается и где заканчивается, линейный это процесс или цикл. Используйте пассив (is collected, are picked).

rubric.en: Task: one sentence says what the diagram shows; the overview gives the number of stages (seven), where the process begins and ends (waste from the canteen, vegetables cooked in the canteen), that it is a cycle, and does not retell every stage.

ask.en: Did you say what the diagram shows, how many stages there are (seven), and that it begins and ends in the canteen, so it is a cycle?
ask.uz: Diagramma nimani koʻrsatishini, nechta bosqich borligini (yettita) va jarayon oshxonada boshlanib, oshxonada tugashini, yaʼni bu aylanma jarayon ekanini aytdingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы сказали, что показывает схема, сколько в ней этапов (семь) и что процесс начинается и заканчивается в столовой, то есть это цикл?

rubric.en: Organisation: the introduction sentence first, then the overview starting with "Overall"; any stages named come in the diagram's order, joined with sequence words (first, next, once this is done, finally).

ask.en: Is the introduction sentence first, and does the overview start with "Overall,"? Are the stages you name in the diagram's order?
ask.uz: Kirish gapi birinchi turibdimi, umumiy koʻrinish «Overall,» bilan boshlanadimi? Siz aytgan bosqichlar diagrammadagi tartibdami?
ask.ru: Вступительное предложение стоит первым, а обзор начинается с «Overall,»? Этапы, которые вы называете, идут в порядке схемы?

rubric.en: Words: words for a process (stage, step, cycle, begins with, ends with), sequence words, and the diagram's words said in other words where possible (waste, leftovers; spread, used).

ask.en: Did you use process words (stage, cycle, begins with) and say at least one stage in your own words?
ask.uz: Jarayon soʻzlarini (stage, cycle, begins with) ishlatdingizmi va kamida bitta bosqichni oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan aytdingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы использовали слова процесса (stage, cycle, begins with) и пересказали хотя бы один этап своими словами?

rubric.en: Grammar: the present simple passive for the stages (is collected, are picked) and correct agreement (the waste is, the vegetables are).

ask.en: Are the stages in the present passive (is collected, are picked)? Check that is and are agree with their subjects.
ask.uz: Bosqichlar hozirgi zamon majhul nisbatidami (is collected, are picked)? is va are oʻz egasiga mosligini tekshiring.
ask.ru: Этапы описаны в пассиве настоящего времени (is collected, are picked)? Проверьте, что is и are согласованы с подлежащим.

title.en: IELTS Writing: Discuss both views and give your opinion
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Ikki qarashni muhokama qilish va oʻz fikringiz
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Обе точки зрения и ваше мнение

body.en:
"Discuss both views and give your own opinion" asks for three things: view A, view B and what you think. An essay that leaves one out does not answer the whole question.
A clear plan:
1. Introduction: the two views in your own words, then your opinion in one sentence.
2. Body paragraph 1: the view you agree with less, explained fairly. Why do people hold it?
3. Body paragraph 2: the view you agree with more, and why it is stronger.
4. Conclusion: your opinion again, in new words.
Useful openings: "Supporters of this view point out that…", "Some people argue that…", "However, I believe that…".
body.uz:
«Discuss both views and give your own opinion» uch narsani soʻraydi: A qarash, B qarash va siz nima deb oʻylaysiz. Bittasini tashlab ketgan insho savolga toʻliq javob bermaydi.
Aniq reja:
1. Kirish: ikki qarash oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan, keyin bitta gapda oʻz fikringiz.
2. 1-asosiy xatboshi: siz kamroq qoʻllab-quvvatlaydigan qarash, xolis tushuntirilgan. Odamlar nega shunday oʻylaydi?
3. 2-asosiy xatboshi: siz koʻproq qoʻllab-quvvatlaydigan qarash va u nega kuchliroq.
4. Xulosa: fikringiz yana bir bor, yangi soʻzlar bilan.
Gapni boshlash uchun foydali iboralar: «Supporters of this view point out that…», «Some people argue that…», «However, I believe that…».
body.ru:
«Discuss both views and give your own opinion» просит три вещи: точку зрения A, точку зрения B и ваше мнение. Эссе, где одной из них нет, отвечает на вопрос не полностью.
Чёткий план:
1. Вступление: обе точки зрения своими словами, затем ваше мнение одним предложением.
2. Основной абзац 1: точка зрения, с которой вы согласны меньше, изложенная объективно. Почему люди так думают?
3. Основной абзац 2: точка зрения, с которой вы согласны больше, и почему она сильнее.
4. Заключение: ваше мнение ещё раз, другими словами.
Полезные начальные фразы: «Supporters of this view point out that…», «Some people argue that…», «However, I believe that…».

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Some people think that school trips are a waste of lesson time. Others believe they teach things that a classroom cannot. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." This is body paragraph 1: the view the writer agrees with less.

Supporters of the first view point out that a school trip can cost a whole day of lessons. When a class travels to a factory or a museum, much of the time is spent on the bus or waiting at the entrance, and teachers may then have to rush through a topic to catch up. For example, a class that loses a Friday to a trip may have only one lesson left before a test. These are fair concerns, and they show that a trip needs a clear purpose. However, they do not mean that trips have no value, as the next paragraph explains.

body.en: Two traps. First: no opinion. "Discuss both views" is only part of the question; without your opinion the essay does not answer it fully. Second: a weak other side. If the view you disagree with gets one short sentence, the discussion is not fair. Give each view its own reason and example.

Siz qoʻllab-quvvatlamaydigan qarashga bitta qisqa gap ajratilsa, muhokama bir tomonlama boʻlib qoladi. Har bir qarashga oʻz sababi va misolini bering.

Если точке зрения, с которой вы не согласны, досталось одно короткое предложение, обсуждение получается однобоким. Дайте каждой точке зрения свою причину и пример.

title.en: IELTS Writing: Topic sentences and supporting a point
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Mavzu gapi va fikrni asoslash
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Тематическое предложение и как подкрепить мысль

body.en:
The first sentence of a body paragraph is its topic sentence: it tells the reader the paragraph's one point. A good topic sentence:
1. Answers the question, not just names the topic.
2. Is a general point, not an example or a fact.
3. Is narrow enough to explain in one paragraph.
Every later sentence supports it in one of three ways:
1. Explain: why or how is it true?
2. Give an example: a typical case.
3. Show the result: what does this mean?
If a sentence does none of these, it belongs in another paragraph.
body.uz:
Asosiy xatboshining birinchi gapi uning mavzu gapi (topic sentence): u oʻquvchiga xatboshining bitta asosiy fikrini aytadi. Yaxshi mavzu gapi:
1. Savolga javob beradi, faqat mavzuni nomlamaydi.
2. Umumiy fikr boʻladi, misol yoki fakt emas.
3. Bitta xatboshida tushuntirsa boʻladigan darajada tor boʻladi.
Keyingi har bir gap uni uch yoʻldan biri bilan qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi:
1. Tushuntirish: bu nega yoki qanday qilib toʻgʻri?
2. Misol: odatiy holat.
3. Natija: bu nimani anglatadi?
Agar gap bularning hech birini qilmasa, u boshqa xatboshiga tegishli.
body.ru:
Первое предложение основного абзаца — тематическое (topic sentence): оно сообщает читателю одну главную мысль абзаца. Хорошее тематическое предложение:
1. Отвечает на вопрос, а не просто называет тему.
2. Это общая мысль, а не пример и не факт.
3. Оно достаточно узкое, чтобы раскрыть его в одном абзаце.
Каждое следующее предложение поддерживает его одним из трёх способов:
1. Объясняет: почему или как это верно?
2. Даёт пример: типичный случай.
3. Показывает результат: что это значит?
Если предложение не делает ничего из этого, ему место в другом абзаце.

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Some schools now give students a tablet instead of paper textbooks. Is this a positive or a negative development?"

The main advantage of tablets is that they make school bags much lighter. A student who carries six or seven paper textbooks every day may have a bag that weighs several kilograms, which is tiring on a long walk to school. With a tablet, all of these books fit into one light device. For example, a student who once needed two bags can now carry one small one. As a result, students arrive at school less tired and always have every book with them. For this reason, I see this change as mainly positive.

body.en: Two traps. First: a topic sentence that is an example or a fact ("My cousin uses a tablet at school."). An example supports a point; it cannot be the point. Second: a sentence that wanders. If the paragraph is about lighter bags, a sentence about games on tablets does not belong in it, even if it is true.
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: misol yoki faktdan iborat mavzu gapi («My cousin uses a tablet at school.»). Misol fikrni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi, lekin oʻzi fikr boʻla olmaydi. Ikkinchisi: mavzudan chetga chiqqan gap. Xatboshi yengilroq sumkalar haqida boʻlsa, planshetdagi oʻyinlar haqidagi gap, rost boʻlsa ham, unga tegishli emas.

Вторая: предложение не по теме. Если абзац о лёгких сумках, предложению об играх на планшете в нём не место, даже если оно верное.

prompt.en: Some schools do not allow students to use their phones at any time during the school day, including break times. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this rule?

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: ONE body paragraph. Start with a topic sentence that answers the question with one general point. Then support it: explain it, give an example and say what this means. Every sentence must serve the topic sentence.

title.en: IELTS Writing: Precise words and collocations
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Aniq soʻzlar va soʻz birikmalari
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Точные слова и устойчивые сочетания

body.en:
Words are one of the four things your writing is judged on. Two habits make yours stronger.
1. Precise words. Change general words for exact ones: good → useful, healthy, reliable; bad → harmful, unfair, noisy; thing → factor, habit, problem; a lot of → many, a large number of.
2. Collocations: words that naturally go together. We say "make a decision", "take responsibility", "pay attention to", "have an effect on", "heavy traffic", "a strong reason".
Learn new words in pairs and short phrases, not one by one. Use a new word only when you are sure of its meaning and its partners.
body.uz:
Soʻzlar yozuvingiz baholanadigan toʻrt narsadan biri. Ikki odat ularni kuchliroq qiladi.
1. Aniq soʻzlar. Umumiy soʻzlarni aniqroqlariga almashtiring: good → useful, healthy, reliable; bad → harmful, unfair, noisy; thing → factor, habit, problem; a lot of → many, a large number of.
2. Soʻz birikmalari (collocations): tabiiy ravishda birga keladigan soʻzlar. Ingliz tilida «make a decision», «take responsibility», «pay attention to», «have an effect on», «heavy traffic», «a strong reason» deyiladi.
Yangi soʻzlarni bittalab emas, juft-juft va qisqa iboralar bilan oʻrganing. Yangi soʻzning maʼnosini va qaysi soʻzlar bilan birga kelishini aniq bilgandagina ishlating.
body.ru:
Лексика — один из четырёх критериев, по которым оценивают ваш текст. Две привычки делают её сильнее.
1. Точные слова. Заменяйте общие слова точными: good → useful, healthy, reliable; bad → harmful, unfair, noisy; thing → factor, habit, problem; a lot of → many, a large number of.
2. Устойчивые сочетания (collocations): слова, которые естественно идут вместе. По-английски говорят «make a decision», «take responsibility», «pay attention to», «have an effect on», «heavy traffic», «a strong reason».
Учите новые слова парами и короткими фразами, а не по одному. Используйте новое слово, только когда уверены в его значении и в словах, с которыми оно сочетается.

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Some people think that cities should plant more trees along their streets. To what extent do you agree or disagree?"

Planting more trees along city streets would have a clear effect on the quality of daily life. Trees provide shade in summer, which makes walking to school or work far more comfortable on hot afternoons. They also reduce noise from heavy traffic, so homes near busy roads become quieter places to rest and study. For example, a street lined with tall trees often feels calmer than a nearby road without them, even when both carry the same number of cars. For these reasons, I strongly believe that city councils should make tree planting a priority.
body.uz:
Boshqa savol uchun namuna (oʻzimizning misol): «Some people think that cities should plant more trees along their streets. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

Planting more trees along city streets would have a clear effect on the quality of daily life. Trees provide shade in summer, which makes walking to school or work far more comfortable on hot afternoons. They also reduce noise from heavy traffic, so homes near busy roads become quieter places to rest and study. For example, a street lined with tall trees often feels calmer than a nearby road without them, even when both carry the same number of cars. For these reasons, I strongly believe that city councils should make tree planting a priority.

Eʼtibor bering: «have a clear effect on», «provide shade», «heavy traffic», «strongly believe», «make … a priority» tabiiy birikmalar; «good» va «thing» kabi umumiy soʻzlar yoʻq.
body.ru:
Образец для другого вопроса (наш собственный пример): «Some people think that cities should plant more trees along their streets. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

Planting more trees along city streets would have a clear effect on the quality of daily life. Trees provide shade in summer, which makes walking to school or work far more comfortable on hot afternoons. They also reduce noise from heavy traffic, so homes near busy roads become quieter places to rest and study. For example, a street lined with tall trees often feels calmer than a nearby road without them, even when both carry the same number of cars. For these reasons, I strongly believe that city councils should make tree planting a priority.

Обратите внимание: «have a clear effect on», «provide shade», «heavy traffic», «strongly believe», «make … a priority» — естественные сочетания; общих слов вроде «good» и «thing» нет.

body.en: Two traps. First: a rare word in the wrong place. A long word that does not fit the meaning ("The weather was very precipitous") is worse than a simple, correct one ("It rained heavily"). Second: wrong partners. "Do a mistake", "make homework" and "say an opinion" are common errors; the right pairs are "make a mistake", "do homework" and "give an opinion".
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: noyob soʻz notoʻgʻri joyda. Maʼnoga mos kelmaydigan uzun soʻz («The weather was very precipitous») oddiy va toʻgʻri soʻzdan («It rained heavily») yomonroq. Ikkinchisi: notoʻgʻri juftlar. «Do a mistake», «make homework» va «say an opinion» keng tarqalgan xatolar; toʻgʻri juftlar esa «make a mistake», «do homework» va «give an opinion».
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: редкое слово не к месту. Длинное слово, которое не подходит по смыслу («The weather was very precipitous»), хуже простого и правильного («It rained heavily»). Вторая: неверные пары. «Do a mistake», «make homework» и «say an opinion» — частые ошибки; правильные пары: «make a mistake», «do homework» и «give an opinion».

title.en: IELTS Writing: Complex sentences without mistakes
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Сложные предложения без ошибок

body.en:
Grammar is judged on two things together: range (different kinds of sentence) and accuracy (few mistakes). A mix of short and longer sentences shows range. Four safe ways to build a longer sentence:
1. because, although, when + a full clause: "Although the plan is expensive, it would save time."
2. who, which, where: "Students who live far away often arrive tired."
3. if: "If cities built more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive."
4. The passive: "More cycle lanes should be built."
Use only the forms you can write without mistakes, and check each long sentence: does every clause have its own subject and verb?
body.uz:
Grammatika bir vaqtning oʻzida ikki jihatdan baholanadi: xilma-xillik (har xil turdagi gaplar) va aniqlik (xatolar kam). Qisqa va uzunroq gaplar aralashmasi xilma-xillikni koʻrsatadi. Uzunroq gap tuzishning toʻrtta ishonchli yoʻli:
1. because, although, when + toʻliq gap: «Although the plan is expensive, it would save time.»
2. who, which, where: «Students who live far away often arrive tired.»
3. if: «If cities built more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive.»
4. Majhul nisbat: «More cycle lanes should be built.»
Faqat xatosiz yoza oladigan shakllaringizni ishlating va har bir uzun gapni tekshiring: uning har bir qismida oʻz egasi va kesimi bormi?
body.ru:
Грамматику оценивают сразу по двум критериям: разнообразие (разные виды предложений) и точность (мало ошибок). Сочетание коротких и длинных предложений показывает разнообразие. Четыре надёжных способа построить длинное предложение:
1. because, although, when + полное предложение: «Although the plan is expensive, it would save time.»
2. who, which, where: «Students who live far away often arrive tired.»
3. if: «If cities built more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive.»
4. Пассив: «More cycle lanes should be built.»
Используйте только те формы, которые пишете без ошибок, и проверяйте каждое длинное предложение: в каждой его части есть своё подлежащее и сказуемое?

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Some people believe that teenagers should help with housework every day. To what extent do you agree or disagree?"

Although many teenagers have long school days, I believe that they should still help with housework every day. Daily tasks, which often take only fifteen minutes, teach young people skills that they will need when they live alone. If a teenager learns to cook a simple meal or to wash clothes, the first year away from home becomes far less stressful. For example, students who have never used a washing machine are often surprised by how much there is to learn. Housework is shared in many families, and it should be shared by teenagers too.
body.uz:
Boshqa savol uchun namuna (oʻzimizning misol): «Some people believe that teenagers should help with housework every day. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

Although many teenagers have long school days, I believe that they should still help with housework every day. Daily tasks, which often take only fifteen minutes, teach young people skills that they will need when they live alone. If a teenager learns to cook a simple meal or to wash clothes, the first year away from home becomes far less stressful. For example, students who have never used a washing machine are often surprised by how much there is to learn. Housework is shared in many families, and it should be shared by teenagers too.

Eʼtibor bering: although, which, if, who va majhul nisbat (is shared) bilan har xil uzun gaplar bor, lekin har birining har bir qismida ega va kesim turibdi.
body.ru:
Образец для другого вопроса (наш собственный пример): «Some people believe that teenagers should help with housework every day. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

Обратите внимание: здесь разные длинные предложения с although, which, if, who и пассивом (is shared), но в каждой части каждого из них есть подлежащее и сказуемое.

body.en: Two traps. First: half a sentence. "Because many students live far from school." stops after the because part. Add the main clause: "Because many students live far from school, they often arrive tired." Second: a sentence that never ends. Clauses joined again and again with "and", "which" and commas are easy to break. If a sentence runs past about 30 words, cut it in two.
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: yarim gap. «Because many students live far from school.» because qismidan keyin toʻxtab qoladi. Bosh gapni qoʻshing: «Because many students live far from school, they often arrive tired.» Ikkinchisi: tugamaydigan gap. «and», «which» va vergullar bilan qayta-qayta ulangan qismlar oson buziladi. Gap taxminan 30 soʻzdan oshsa, uni ikkiga boʻling.
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: половина предложения. «Because many students live far from school.» обрывается после части с because. Добавьте главное предложение: «Because many students live far from school, they often arrive tired.» Вторая: предложение, которое не кончается. Части, снова и снова соединённые через «and», «which» и запятые, легко ломаются. Если предложение длиннее примерно 30 слов, разделите его на два.

title.en: IELTS Writing: The full test in 60 minutes and the self-check
title.uz: IELTS Writing: 60 daqiqalik toʻliq test va oʻz-oʻzini tekshirish
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Полный тест за 60 минут и самопроверка

body.en:
The Writing test is two tasks in 60 minutes, and you share the time yourself:
1. Task 1: about 20 minutes, at least 150 words.
2. Task 2: about 40 minutes, at least 250 words. It counts twice as much as Task 1, so never give Task 2's minutes to Task 1.
Inside Task 2: about 5 minutes to plan, 30 to write and 5 to check.
Check with the four questions of this course:
1. Did I answer the whole question?
2. Is it in a clear order?
3. Are my words exact?
4. Are my sentences correct?
In the last minutes, look for the mistakes you make most often, such as a missing -s or a wrong tense.
body.uz:
Writing testi 60 daqiqada ikkita topshiriqdan iborat, vaqtni oʻzingiz taqsimlaysiz:
1. Task 1: taxminan 20 daqiqa, kamida 150 soʻz.
2. Task 2: taxminan 40 daqiqa, kamida 250 soʻz. Bahoga u Task 1 dan ikki baravar koʻp taʼsir qiladi, shuning uchun Task 1 uning vaqtini olmasin.
Task 2 ichida: taxminan 5 daqiqa reja, 30 daqiqa yozish va 5 daqiqa tekshirish.
Shu kursning toʻrt savoli bilan tekshiring:
1. Butun savolga javob berdimmi?
2. Tartib aniqmi?
3. Soʻzlarim aniqmi?
4. Gaplarim toʻgʻrimi?
Oxirgi daqiqalarda eng koʻp qiladigan xatolaringizni qidiring, masalan, tushib qolgan -s yoki notoʻgʻri zamon.
body.ru:
Writing — это два задания за 60 минут, и время вы распределяете сами:
1. Task 1: около 20 минут, не меньше 150 слов.
2. Task 2: около 40 минут, не меньше 250 слов. Оно весит вдвое больше, чем Task 1, поэтому никогда не тратьте его минуты на Task 1.
Внутри Task 2: около 5 минут на план, 30 на письмо и 5 на проверку.
Проверяйте себя четырьмя вопросами этого курса:
1. Есть ответ на весь вопрос?
2. Порядок ясный?
3. Слова точные?
4. Предложения правильные?
В последние минуты ищите ошибки, которые делаете чаще всего, например пропущенное -s или не то время.

body.en:
A model for another question, written in 10 minutes (our own example): "Some people think that students should be able to choose all of their school subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?"

I partly agree that students should choose their own subjects, because choice makes learning more personal. A student who has chosen biology, for example, is more likely to read about it at home and to ask questions in class. However, teenagers do not always know which subjects they will need later. A fourteen-year-old who drops mathematics may find, years afterwards, that the university course she wants requires it. For this reason, I believe that schools should keep a few core subjects for everyone and let students choose the rest.

The writer's check, 2 minutes:
1. The whole question? Yes: a clear position (I partly agree) and a reason on each side.
2. A clear order? Point, example, the other side, my view.
3. Exact words? "core subjects", "drops mathematics", "more personal".
4. Correct sentences? Every clause has a subject and a verb; "requires" agrees with "course".
body.uz:
Boshqa savol uchun 10 daqiqada yozilgan namuna (oʻzimizning misol): «Some people think that students should be able to choose all of their school subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

I partly agree that students should choose their own subjects, because choice makes learning more personal. A student who has chosen biology, for example, is more likely to read about it at home and to ask questions in class. However, teenagers do not always know which subjects they will need later. A fourteen-year-old who drops mathematics may find, years afterwards, that the university course she wants requires it. For this reason, I believe that schools should keep a few core subjects for everyone and let students choose the rest.

Muallifning tekshiruvi, 2 daqiqa:
1. Butun savolga javobmi? Ha: aniq pozitsiya (I partly agree) va har ikki tomonga sabab.
2. Tartib aniqmi? Fikr, misol, qarshi tomon, mening fikrim.
3. Soʻzlar aniqmi? «core subjects», «drops mathematics», «more personal».
4. Gaplar toʻgʻrimi? Har bir qismida ega va kesim bor; «requires» «course» ga mos.
body.ru:
Образец для другого вопроса, написанный за 10 минут (наш собственный пример): «Some people think that students should be able to choose all of their school subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?»

I partly agree that students should choose their own subjects, because choice makes learning more personal. A student who has chosen biology, for example, is more likely to read about it at home and to ask questions in class. However, teenagers do not always know which subjects they will need later. A fourteen-year-old who drops mathematics may find, years afterwards, that the university course she wants requires it. For this reason, I believe that schools should keep a few core subjects for everyone and let students choose the rest.

Проверка автора, 2 минуты:
1. Ответ на весь вопрос? Да: ясная позиция (I partly agree) и причина с каждой стороны.
2. Порядок ясный? Мысль, пример, другая сторона, моё мнение.
3. Слова точные? «core subjects», «drops mathematics», «more personal».
4. Предложения правильные? В каждой части есть подлежащее и сказуемое; «requires» согласовано с «course».

body.en: Two traps. First: too long on Task 1. It is the shorter task and counts for less; at about 20 minutes, finish it and move on. Second: no time to check. Three minutes at the end catch the mistakes you make most often, and a quick look shows whether each task is long enough.
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: Task 1 ga juda koʻp vaqt. U qisqaroq va bahoga taʼsiri kamroq; taxminan 20 daqiqada uni tugating va keyingisiga oʻting. Ikkinchisi: tekshirishga vaqt qolmasligi. Oxirgi uch daqiqada eng koʻp qiladigan xatolaringizni topib olasiz, bir qarashda esa har bir topshiriq yetarlicha uzunmi, shuni koʻrasiz.
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: слишком долго на Task 1. Это более короткое задание, и весит оно меньше; примерно через 20 минут закончите его и переходите дальше. Вторая: нет времени на проверку. За три минуты в конце можно поймать ошибки, которые вы делаете чаще всего, а беглый взгляд покажет, хватает ли слов в каждом задании.

prompt.en: Some people believe that the best way to learn about another country is to visit it. Others think that books, films and the internet are enough. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

stem.en:
A chart shows how many cups of three drinks a school café sold each week in 2019 and in 2024 (our own invented data):
2019: tea 300, juice 200, hot chocolate 100
2024: tea 250, juice 150, hot chocolate 300

Which is the best overview sentence?

options.en: Overall, hot chocolate sales tripled and it became the best seller, while tea and juice both sold less.
Overall, the café sold 300 cups of tea, 200 cups of juice and 100 cups of hot chocolate a week in 2019.
Overall, tea remained the best seller, while hot chocolate sales rose sharply.
Overall, hot chocolate became more popular because the winters were colder.

why.en: It names the biggest change and compares, and the data agree: hot chocolate went from 100 to 300 and led in 2024. A list of numbers is no overview, and the chart gives no reasons.
why.uz: U eng katta oʻzgarishni aytadi va solishtiradi: issiq shokolad savdosi 100 dan 300 ga oʻsdi va 2024-yilda birinchi boʻldi. Raqamlar roʻyxati umumiy koʻrinish emas, grafikda sabab yoʻq.
why.ru: Оно называет главное изменение и сравнивает, и данные это подтверждают: продажи горячего шоколада выросли со 100 до 300, и в 2024 году он стал первым. Список цифр — не обзор, а причин график не даёт.

instructions.en: Read the data. Choose the sentence that gives the best overview.
instructions.uz: Maʼlumotlarni oʻqing. Eng yaxshi umumiy koʻrinish beradigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте данные. Выберите предложение, которое даёт лучший обзор.

stem.en:
A science fair had 400 visitors in 2015, 800 in 2020 and 700 in 2023 (our own invented data).

Which sentence describes the data with no mistake?

options.en: The number of visitors doubled between 2015 and 2020 and then fell slightly.
The number of visitors doubles between 2015 and 2020 and then falls slightly.
The number of visitors tripled between 2015 and 2020 and then fell slightly.
The number of visitors was higher in 2020.

why.en: 400 to 800 is double and 800 to 700 a small fall, told in the past tense. "Doubles" is the wrong tense, "tripled" the wrong number, and "higher" needs "than".
why.uz: 400 dan 800 ga ikki baravar, 800 dan 700 ga biroz kamayish, oʻtgan zamonda. «doubles» notoʻgʻri zamon, «tripled» notoʻgʻri raqam, «higher» dan keyin «than» kerak.
why.ru: С 400 до 800 — вдвое, с 800 до 700 — небольшое падение, в прошедшем времени. «doubles» — не то время, «tripled» — не та цифра, после «higher» нужно «than».

instructions.en: Read the data. Choose the sentence with no mistake in tense, numbers or comparison.
instructions.uz: Maʼlumotlarni oʻqing. Zamon, raqam va solishtirishda xatosi yoʻq gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте данные. Выберите предложение без ошибок во времени, цифрах и сравнении.

stem.en:
A diagram shows how used glass bottles in one town become new bottles (our own invented process):
1. Bottles are collected from street bins.
2. They are sorted by colour.
3. They are crushed into small pieces.
4. The pieces are melted in a furnace.
5. The liquid glass is shaped into new bottles.
6. The new bottles are filled and sent to shops.

Which is the best overview of this process?

options.en: Overall, the process has six stages, from collecting used bottles to sending new ones to shops.
Overall, the bottles are collected, then sorted, then crushed, then melted, then shaped and then filled.
Overall, the process has five stages, from sorting the bottles by colour to filling the new ones.
Overall, recycling glass is good for the town because it saves money.

why.en: It gives the number of stages (six) and the first and the last. Listing every stage is no overview, "five stages" is wrong, and the diagram gives no reasons.
why.uz: U bosqichlar sonini (oltita), birinchi va oxirgisini aytadi. Har bir bosqichni sanab chiqish umumiy koʻrinish emas, «five stages» notoʻgʻri, diagrammada esa sabab yoʻq.
why.ru: Оно называет число этапов (шесть), первый и последний. Перечень всех этапов — не обзор, «five stages» — неверно, а причин схема не даёт.

instructions.en: Read the diagram. Choose the sentence that gives the best overview.
instructions.uz: Diagrammani oʻqing. Eng yaxshi umumiy koʻrinish beradigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте схему. Выберите предложение, которое даёт лучший обзор.

stem.en:
Two maps show a village square in 2005 and today (our own invented maps).
2005: a car park in the centre, a bakery on the north side
Today: a playground in the centre, the bakery still on the north side

Which sentence describes the change correctly?

options.en: The car park in the centre has been replaced by a playground, while the bakery has stayed where it was.
The playground in the centre has been replaced by a car park, while the bakery has stayed where it was.
The bakery on the north side has been replaced by a playground, while the car park has stayed where it was.
The car park in the centre is replaced by a playground in 2005, while the bakery stays where it is.

why.en: The car park of 2005 is a playground today and the bakery did not move: the present perfect fits. The others turn the change round, move the wrong building or use the wrong tense.
why.uz: 2005-yildagi avtoturargoh bugun oʻyin maydonchasi, novvoyxona joyida qolgan: present perfect toʻgʻri. Qolganlari oʻzgarishni teskari aytadi, boshqa binoni koʻchiradi yoki notoʻgʻri zamonni ishlatadi.
why.ru: Парковка 2005 года сегодня стала детской площадкой, пекарня на месте: present perfect верен. Остальные переворачивают изменение, переносят не то здание или берут не то время.

instructions.en: Read the two maps. Choose the sentence that describes the change correctly.
instructions.uz: Ikki xaritani oʻqing. Oʻzgarishni toʻgʻri tasvirlagan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте две карты. Выберите предложение, которое верно описывает изменение.

stem.en:
Question: Some people think that every teenager should learn to play a musical instrument. Others say this time is better spent on sport. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Which introduction sentence covers all three parts of the question?

options.en: While some value music and others prefer sport, I believe teenagers should try both before choosing one.
Many teenagers today play an instrument or a sport after school.
Some people think every teenager should learn an instrument, while others think sport is a better use of this time.
In my opinion, every teenager should play a sport after school.

why.en: It names both views (music and sport) and gives an opinion. Of the others, one only names the topic, one gives both views but no opinion, and one gives an opinion but no views.
why.uz: U ikki qarashni (musiqa va sport) aytadi va fikr bildiradi. Qolganlaridan biri faqat mavzuni aytadi, biri ikki qarashni aytadi-yu fikr bermaydi, biri fikr aytadi-yu qarashlarni bermaydi.
why.ru: Оно называет обе точки зрения (музыка и спорт) и даёт мнение. Из остальных одно лишь называет тему, в другом нет мнения, в третьем нет точек зрения.

instructions.en: Read the question. Choose the introduction sentence that answers the whole question.
instructions.uz: Savolni oʻqing. Butun savolga javob beradigan kirish gapini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте вопрос. Выберите вступительное предложение, которое отвечает на весь вопрос.

stem.en:
Question: Some people think that students should wear a school uniform. Others say students should choose their own clothes. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Which essay plan answers the whole question?

options.en: Introduction: both views and my opinion. Body 1: why some want their own clothes. Body 2: why uniforms are better, in my view. Conclusion: my opinion.
Introduction: my opinion. Body 1: why uniforms are better. Body 2: more reasons why uniforms are better. Conclusion: my opinion.
Introduction: both views. Body 1: why some want uniforms. Body 2: why some want their own clothes. Conclusion: a summary of both views.
Introduction: my opinion. Body 1: the history of school uniforms. Body 2: the price of uniforms. Conclusion: my opinion.

why.en: It has both views, each in its own paragraph, and the writer's opinion. One plan gives only one side, one has no opinion, and one is about history and price, which the question does not ask.
why.uz: Unda ikki qarash (har biri alohida xatboshida) va muallifning fikri bor. Bir reja faqat bir tomonni beradi, birida fikr yoʻq, biri esa savol soʻramagan tarix va narx haqida.
why.ru: В нём обе точки зрения, каждая в своём абзаце, и мнение автора. Один план даёт только одну сторону, в другом нет мнения, третий — об истории и цене, о которых вопрос не спрашивает.

instructions.en: Read the question. Choose the plan that answers all of it.
instructions.uz: Savolni oʻqing. Unga toʻliq javob beradigan rejani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте вопрос. Выберите план, который отвечает на него полностью.

stem.en:
Question: Some people think that town centres should be closed to cars at weekends. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Which is the best topic sentence for a body paragraph that agrees?

options.en: Closing town centres to cars at weekends would make them safer and more pleasant for people on foot.
Last Saturday, my family walked through our town centre for two hours.
Many town centres have cars, buses, shops and cafés.
Closing town centres to cars would change many things, such as shops, traffic, safety, noise, tourism and local jobs.

why.en: It answers the question with one general point that a paragraph can explain. Of the others, one is an example, one only describes town centres, and one lists too many points and takes no side.
why.uz: U savolga bitta xatboshida tushuntirsa boʻladigan umumiy fikr bilan javob beradi. Qolganlaridan biri misol, biri faqat shahar markazini tasvirlaydi, biri pozitsiyasiz juda koʻp narsa sanaydi.
why.ru: Оно отвечает на вопрос одной общей мыслью, которую можно раскрыть в абзаце. Из остальных одно — пример, другое лишь описывает центр города, третье перечисляет слишком много и не занимает позицию.

instructions.en: Read the question. Choose the best topic sentence.
instructions.uz: Savolni oʻqing. Eng yaxshi mavzu gapini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте вопрос. Выберите лучшее тематическое предложение.

stem.en:
Topic sentence: "Keeping a pet teaches children to be responsible."
The rest of the paragraph: A dog or a cat needs food and water at the same times every day, so a child who looks after it learns that someone depends on them. For example, a child who must walk the dog before school soon learns to get up on time. Pets can also be expensive, as food and visits to the vet cost money. In this way, caring for an animal builds habits that help in other parts of life.

Which sentence does not support the topic sentence?

options.en: Pets can also be expensive, as food and visits to the vet cost money.
For example, a child who must walk the dog before school soon learns to get up on time.
A dog or a cat needs food and water at the same times every day, so a child who looks after it learns that someone depends on them.
In this way, caring for an animal builds habits that help in other parts of life.

why.en: Cost is a different point: it does not show that children become responsible. The other three explain the point, give an example and show the result.
why.uz: Narx boshqa fikr: u bolalar masʼuliyatli boʻlishini koʻrsatmaydi. Qolgan uchtasi fikrni tushuntiradi, misol keltiradi va natijani koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Цена — другая мысль: она не показывает, что дети становятся ответственными. Остальные три объясняют мысль, дают пример и показывают результат.

instructions.en: Read the paragraph. Choose the sentence that does not support the topic sentence.
instructions.uz: Xatboshini oʻqing. Mavzu gapini qoʻllab-quvvatlamaydigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте абзац. Выберите предложение, которое не поддерживает тематическое.

stem.en:
A sentence from a student's essay: "Cycling to school is good for teenagers because it keeps their hearts and muscles strong."

Which word is the most precise replacement for "good" in this sentence?

options.en: beneficial
nice
kind
precious

why.en: "Beneficial for" says exactly how cycling is good: it helps the body. "Nice" is still general, "kind" is said of people, and "precious" means dear or rare.
why.uz: «Beneficial for» velosipedda yurish aynan qanday foydali ekanini aytadi: u tanaga foyda keltiradi. «Nice» hali ham umumiy, «kind» odamlarga nisbatan aytiladi, «precious» esa qadrli yoki noyob degani.
why.ru: «Beneficial for» точно говорит, чем полезна езда на велосипеде: она помогает телу. «Nice» по-прежнему общее, «kind» говорят о людях, а «precious» значит «ценный» или «редкий».

instructions.en: Read the sentence. Choose the most precise word to replace the general one.
instructions.uz: Gapni oʻqing. Umumiy soʻz oʻrniga eng aniq soʻzni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте предложение. Выберите самое точное слово вместо общего.

stem.en: Which sentence uses every word pair correctly?

options.en: Students who pay attention to the teacher and take responsibility for their homework usually have fewer problems before exams.
Students who give attention to the teacher and take responsibility for their homework usually have fewer problems before exams.
Students who pay attention to the teacher and make responsibility for their homework usually have fewer problems before exams.
Students who pay attention at the teacher and take responsibility for their homework usually have fewer problems before exams.

why.en: The natural pairs are "pay attention to" and "take responsibility for". "Give attention", "make responsibility" and "attention at" are wrong partners.
why.uz: Tabiiy juftlar «pay attention to» va «take responsibility for». «Give attention», «make responsibility» va «attention at» notoʻgʻri juftlar.
why.ru: Естественные пары — «pay attention to» и «take responsibility for». «Give attention», «make responsibility» и «attention at» — неверные сочетания.

instructions.en: Choose the sentence in which every word pair is natural.
instructions.uz: Har bir soʻz jufti tabiiy boʻlgan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите предложение, в котором каждая пара слов естественна.

stem.en: Which sentence has no grammar mistake?

options.en: Students who sleep well usually concentrate better, although they may study for fewer hours.
Students which sleep well usually concentrate better, although they may study for fewer hours.
Students who sleep well usually concentrate better, although may study for fewer hours.
Students who sleeps well usually concentrate better, although they may study for fewer hours.

why.en: "Who" is for people, "sleep" agrees with "students", and the although clause has its subject, "they". Each of the others breaks one of these.
why.uz: «Who» odamlar uchun, «sleep» «students» ga mos, although qismida esa ega bor («they»). Qolganlarining har birida shulardan biri buzilgan.
why.ru: «Who» — для людей, «sleep» согласовано со «students», а в части с although есть подлежащее «they». В каждом из остальных нарушено одно из этих правил.

instructions.en: Choose the sentence with no grammar mistake.

stem.en: Which of these is one complete, correct sentence?

options.en: Because the bus was late, many students missed the first lesson.
Because the bus was late and many students missed the first lesson.
The bus was late, many students missed the first lesson.
Although the bus was late, but many students missed the first lesson.

why.en: It has a because clause and a main clause. Of the others, one has no main clause, one joins two sentences with only a comma, and one uses although and but together.
why.uz: Unda because qismi ham, bosh gap ham bor. Qolganlaridan birida bosh gap yoʻq, biri ikki gapni faqat vergul bilan ulaydi, biri esa although va but ni birga ishlatadi.
why.ru: В нём есть часть с because и главное предложение. Из остальных в одном нет главного, в другом два предложения соединены одной запятой, в третьем although и but стоят вместе.

instructions.en: Choose the one complete and correct sentence.
instructions.uz: Toʻliq va toʻgʻri tuzilgan bitta gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите одно полное и правильное предложение.

stem.en: A student has 60 minutes for the whole Writing test. Which plan uses the time best?

options.en: About 20 minutes on Task 1 and about 40 on Task 2, with a few minutes inside Task 2 to plan and to check.
About 30 minutes on each task, because the two tasks count the same.
About 20 minutes on Task 1 and about 40 on Task 2, with no planning, so that there is more time to write.
About 10 minutes on Task 1 and about 50 on Task 2, because Task 1 is the shorter task.

why.en: Task 2 counts twice as much, so it gets about 40 minutes, and a plan and a check make that time count. The tasks do not count the same, and 10 minutes is too little for a whole Task 1.
why.uz: Task 2 bahoga ikki baravar koʻp taʼsir qiladi, shuning uchun unga taxminan 40 daqiqa, reja va tekshirish esa vaqtni foydali qiladi. Topshiriqlar teng emas, 10 daqiqa butun Task 1 uchun juda kam.
why.ru: Task 2 весит вдвое больше, поэтому на него отводят около 40 минут, а план и проверка делают это время полезным. Задания весят неодинаково, а 10 минут на весь Task 1 слишком мало.

instructions.en: Choose the time plan that fits the real test.
instructions.uz: Haqiqiy testga mos keladigan vaqt rejasini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите план времени, который подходит для настоящего теста.

stem.en: In the last three minutes, a student checks four sentences from a Task 2 essay. Which sentence fails the check "Are my sentences correct?"

options.en: Visiting a country teach you things that no book can.
Many people learn a language faster when they live in the country where it is spoken.
Books and films show a country, but a visit lets you meet its people.
A short visit can be expensive, so many students learn from films instead.

why.en: "Visiting a country" is one thing, so its verb needs -s: "teaches". The other three sentences are correct.
why.uz: «Visiting a country» bitta narsa, shuning uchun uning feʼliga -s kerak: «teaches». Qolgan uch gap toʻgʻri.
why.ru: «Visiting a country» — это одно действие, поэтому его глаголу нужно -s: «teaches». Остальные три предложения правильные.

instructions.en: Read the four sentences. Choose the one with a grammar mistake.
instructions.uz: Toʻrt gapni oʻqing. Grammatik xatosi bor gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте четыре предложения. Выберите то, в котором есть грамматическая ошибка.
